# idomaps

> idomaps is a free, browser-based thematic map editor. Draw polygons, lines, points, and text on real base maps, style them, organize them with groups and a legend, then export to GeoJSON or share an interactive map online. No installation, no account required to start.

## What it is

idomaps is an online cartography tool for making thematic and reference maps: historical maps, territory and boundary maps, travel and field maps, data/choropleth maps, and explainer maps for articles or teaching. It runs entirely in the browser.

## Key facts

- Free to use. No signup required to create a map (sign up only to save).
- Import and export GeoJSON; export to the .idomaps format.
- Draw polygons, polylines, points, text, arrows, circles, rectangles.
- Per-feature styling: colors, opacity, fill patterns, line styles, custom SVG markers, icons, hover highlight color.
- Groups and a legend system with shared styles.
- Choropleth maps from country/region tiles.
- Multiple base maps (OpenStreetMap, Voyager, Topographic, Satellite, and more).
- Publish a map at a public URL or embed it on any website with an iframe.
- Overlapping polygons: hovering aggregates every shape under the cursor so nothing is hidden.

## Common use cases

- Education: history and geography teaching maps (migrations, trade routes, territories).
- Research and journalism: explanatory maps with sourced descriptions.
- Travel and outdoors: route and point-of-interest maps.
- Worldbuilding and content creation.

- Try it now (no signup): https://idomaps.app/try
